name: Notion
short_description: Search, read, create, and edit Notion pages and databases directly from your agent.
store_description: Notion's official hosted MCP server. Connects your agent to any Notion workspace via OAuth 2.0 with PKCE and dynamic client registration (DCR) — no API key or integration to create beforehand. Exposes Notion's agent-optimized toolset: cross-source search (across connected Slack, Google Drive, GitHub, Jira, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Linear connectors if enabled in Notion), page and database fetch, page creation and editing, database queries, page duplication, comments, teamspaces, and user listing. Every tool runs with the connected user's full Notion permissions — access is scoped entirely by the workspace membership of the person who authorizes.
description: Official Notion-hosted MCP server. Search, read, and edit your Notion workspace via OAuth 2.0.
usage_hint: This server is hosted by Notion and authenticated via OAuth. Transport is Streamable HTTP (POST only, no SSE). Tools follow Notion's own naming: 'search' (find pages/databases by title or content), 'fetch' (retrieve a page/database by URL or ID), 'create_page', 'update_page', 'query_database', 'create_database', 'create_comment', 'get_comments'. WORKFLOW: (1) If you do not know the exact page/database ID, call 'search' first — guessing IDs will fail. (2) 'search' can also reach connected sources (Slack, Drive, GitHub, etc.) if the user has enabled Notion AI connectors — the results include a 'source' field distinguishing Notion objects from connector hits. (3) When creating or updating content, always fetch the parent page first to inspect its schema (property names and types) before writing. Tool calls execute with the authorized user's full Notion permissions; there is no per-tool scoping in this server.
